mapper.select: SELECT record_id AS recordId, user_id AS userId, record_date AS recordDate, content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND record_date = #{recordDate}
SELECT record_id AS recordId, user_id AS userId, record_date AS recordDate, content, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM record WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO record (user_id, record_date, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{recordDate}, #{content}::jsonb, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE record SET content = #{content}::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
